captions.caption: A man in a green shirt pulls a large branch through a dense forest.
The man picks up a long wooden pole and walks toward a cleared area.
He carries the pole across the clearing where other poles are lying.
The man sets down the pole and moves toward his gear on the ground.
He uses a large knife to begin trimming the end of the wooden pole.
The man continues shaving bark off the end of the pole with his knife.
He keeps working on the pole's end, removing thin layers of wood.
The man finishes trimming the pole and prepares to move it.
He picks up the sharpened pole and walks toward a pre-dug hole.
The man positions the pole vertically above the small hole in the ground.
He inserts the base of the pole into the hole and adjusts its position.
The man holds the pole upright, ensuring it is straight in the ground.
He releases the pole and steps back slightly to evaluate its placement.
The man walks away from the first pole to retrieve another one.
He picks up a second long pole from the forest floor.
The man carries the second pole toward another hole in the clearing.
He approaches the hole with the second pole held vertically.
The man carefully places the base of the second pole into the hole.
He adjusts the pole's height and angle within the hole.
The man pushes down on the pole to seat it firmly in the soil.
He checks the stability of the pole by giving it a slight shake.
The camera focuses on the base of the pole as the man begins to work.
The man starts pushing loose dirt into the hole around the pole.
He uses his foot to kick more dirt into the gap around the base.
The man continues using his boot to pack dirt firmly around the pole.
He kneels down on one knee to get closer to the base of the pole.
The man uses his hands to scoop dirt into the hole.
He continues filling the hole with soil by hand, packing it down.
The man reaches for a rock to use as a wedge for the pole.
He places a large rock into the hole next to the wooden pole.
The man pushes the rock deep into the hole to stabilize the pole.
He adjusts the pole's verticality while holding it with one hand.
The man picks up another rock and prepares to place it.
He inserts the second rock into the hole on the opposite side.
The man uses his hands to pack more dirt over the rocks in the hole.
He firmly presses the soil down around the rocks and the pole.
The man continues the process of filling and tamping the earth.
He reaches for another small stone from a nearby pile.
The man places the stone into a gap in the hole around the pole.
He covers the stone with a handful of loose dirt.
The man uses his fingers to pack the dirt tightly into the crevices.
He scoops up more soil from the ground next to him.
The man spreads the soil evenly around the base of the pole.
He continues to firm up the ground by pressing down with his hands.
The man stands up slightly to reach for more dirt further away.
He kneels back down and resumes packing the base of the pole.
The man pushes a significant amount of dirt into the remaining opening.
He checks the alignment of the pole one more time.
The man adds a final small rock to the base for extra support.
He packs the area around the new rock with more soil.
The man continues to work on securing the pole in the ground.
He uses his fingertips to ensure the dirt is well-distributed.
The man smooths the surface of the dirt around the base.
He keeps tamping the earth to make it as solid as possible.
The man grabs one more handful of dry soil from the side.
He sprinkles the loose dirt over the packed area around the pole.
The man uses his palm to flatten and firm the top layer of soil.
He finishes securing the pole and inspects the base.
The man looks at the upright pole, satisfied with its stability.
He begins to move away from the pole to start the next task.
